title: Check yourself: The assistant: persona, memory and the window

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: A customer's message to the example assistant asks to speak to a human and, in the same sentence, says they might hurt themselves. Where does the route lead?

options.text: To a request hand-off, since asking for a person is stated first in the sentence
options.says: Ruled out because the order puts safety above a request: "a signal of risk goes to a person, a request for a person is honoured, a stalled conversation is handed over after two misses".

options.text: To a safety hand-off, since a signal of risk is checked first
To the model, since it weighs the two parts of the message together before it replies
options.says: Ruled out because the decision is made before the model sees the message: "Before the model sees a message, code checks it in a fixed order".

options.text: To a stalled hand-off, since two questions have gone unanswered in the conversation
options.says: Ruled out because the stall comes last: "a message that asks for a human and also signals risk is a safety hand-off".

questions.stem: The example recalls two facts for a customer on 2026-10-04: an address saved on 2026-09-20 and a plan saved on 2025-12-01, with a limit of thirty days. What does the assistant do with them?

options.text: Treats both as current and goes on to use them
options.says: Ruled out because an old fact is not trusted: "a fact that has not been touched for months is more likely to be wrong than one from last week".

options.text: Uses the postal one and has the subscription one confirmed before relying on it
options.says: The address is current and the plan is marked to be verified.

options.text: Drops both facts from the conversation and starts afresh
options.says: Ruled out because the old fact is checked and not thrown away: "so that the assistant asks the customer before it relies on an address from last year".

options.text: Verifies both facts with the person before saying anything else to them in the conversation
options.says: Ruled out because only the old fact needs confirming: "the example marks each fact `current` when it is no older than a limit, and `verify` when it is older".

questions.stem: A team stores memory files for all customers under one directory and serves any path that begins with `/memories`. A request arrives for `/memories/../../secrets.env`. What is the documentation's guidance?

options.text: Allow it on the strength of the matching prefix of the memory area
options.says: Ruled out because the prefix is not enough: "A malicious path such as `/memories/../../secrets.env` can reach files outside the `/memories` directory".

options.text: Let the model decide whether the file is sensitive before anything is returned to it
options.says: Ruled out because a decision by the model is a request and not a guarantee: "A refusal that usually happens is a request, and a handler that strips is a guarantee."

options.text: Check each one in every command and refuse whatever resolves outside the root
Rely on the platform to confine every file operation to the memory area
options.says: Ruled out because the platform does not execute the operations: "The memory tool operates client-side: Claude requests file operations, and your application executes them."

concepts: Memory that crosses sessions, as the page teaches it
